about: NOT A NETWORK. The built-in profile placeholder of the extension (decision D1, development/handoff SITES-PLAN): the spec-2 (v3) devnet GenesisSpec of the decoder corpus (prototypes/pocol-extension/tests/data/decoder-corpus-v3.json, item v3/base: the devnet spec naming the v3 program set) under the chain ID 1234567891, which no network uses. set_network_identity.py --placeholder writes it into the extension; the identity switch replaces it; the release packager refuses a build that carries it. Never launched, never seeded.
